per_locus.title: Unsigned validity window metadata
per_locus.evidence: F-001 is verbatim the awarded M-01: validUntil/validAfter appended to the AtomWallet signature are not part of the signed userOpHash, so a relayer/bundler can alter the validity window without invalidating the ECDSA signature. Mechanism derived blind from reading _validateSignature/_extractValidUntilAndValidAfterFromSignature.

per_locus.title: Epoch-boundary checkpoints retroactively qualify for the previous epoch's rewards
per_locus.evidence: Awarded M-02: epoch-boundary veTRUST checkpoints retroactively qualify for the previous epoch via inclusive timestamp lookups in the reward snapshot. I deep-read TrustBonding's epoch-end snapshot path (userBondedBalanceAtEpochEnd/_userEligibleRewardsForEpoch at _epochTimestampEnd) and surfaced a different emissions-accounting issue there (F-003 unclaimed-rewards max-vs-adjusted) but did NOT isolate the boundary-inclusive checkpoint mechanism (which partly lives in the out-of-scope VotingEscrow dependency). Same reward-snapshot subsystem, different mechanism.
